To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) NGS technology is a useful tool for seafood traceability, (2) mislabeling of surimi products was found, and (3) the use of vulnerable species in surimi products was proved.
(i) the PGM platform is a useful tool for species identification in surimi products; (ii) the mislabelling rate in surimi products is high and (iii) the use of vulnerable species is proved.
Next Generation Sequencing is an effective method to identify species in complex food matrices and that it can be used to detect the presence of undeclared species and the use of vulnerable species.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the fish and cephalopus species present in surimi products.
the development of new tools to improve the food inspection, with the final aim of protecting consumers' health.
the development of new analytical tools for food traceability and authenticity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of NGS technologies in the food industry represents a great improvement for the food traceability and food safety.
the Ion Torrent PGM is a promising and cost effective technology for the analysis of highly processed food matrices.
NGS technologies are a promising tool in food inspection and traceability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
NGS technologies are a valid and promising tool for the food inspection field.
the use of NGS technologies in seafood inspection could be a valid tool for the analysis and identification of complex, highly-processed products.
NGS is a promising tool for the analysis and identification of complex food matrices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the application of NGS technologies in food traceability can provide valuable information for consumers.
, in the era of NGS technologies, the use of vulnerable species in food products, as well as their misdeclaration, should be considered as a potential threat to the EU food chain.
the use of NGS technologies is a powerful tool to detect species in highly complex food products, such as surimi, which are often mislabelled.
